user.title: Everlights account
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use in the Everlights app. Home Assistant talks to your bridge through the Everlights cloud, because bridge firmware B5010 and newer no longer allow local control.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Everlights again
reauth_confirm.description: Everlights rejected the saved password for {username}.

abort.already_configured: This Everlights account is already set up.

error.invalid_auth: Everlights rejected that email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Everlights cloud.
error.no_bridges: This account has no Everlights bridge paired to it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Drops what Home Assistant sent to the zone and hands it back to the schedule on the bridge. With nothing scheduled, the lights go off.

save_sequence.name: Save sequence
save_sequence.description: Saves colors and effects as a sequence on the bridge. It shows up as an effect and in the EverLights app under Personal.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the new sequence. It must not match an existing one.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: List of RRGGBB colors. Leave empty to save what the light is showing now.

effects.name: Effects
effects.description: Effect types mapped to a strength from 0 to 255, for example chase: 100. Leave empty to keep the effects the light is showing now.

delete_sequence.name: Delete sequence
delete_sequence.description: Deletes one of your own saved sequences from the bridge. Built-in sequences can't be deleted.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the sequence to delete.

update_sequence.name: Update sequence
update_sequence.description: Changes the colors, effects, or name of one of your own saved sequences. Built-in sequences can't be changed.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the sequence to change.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: Rename the sequence. Leave empty to keep its name.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: List of RRGGBB colors that replaces the current ones. Leave empty to keep them.

effects.name: Effects
effects.description: Effect types mapped to a strength from 0 to 255. Replaces the current effects. Leave empty to keep them.

schedule_show.name: Schedule show
schedule_show.description: Schedules a show on the bridge. The bridge runs it by itself, even if Home Assistant is down. During the show it cycles through the sequences.

sequences.name: Sequences
sequences.description: Sequence names mapped to how many seconds each one shows, or a plain list of names for 20 seconds each.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the first night. It can be past midnight.

nights.name: Nights
nights.description: How many nights in a row to repeat it.

start_at_dusk.name: Start at dusk
start_at_dusk.description: Let the bridge start at dusk instead of the start time. The date still comes from the start.

end_at_dawn.name: End at dawn
end_at_dawn.description: Let the bridge end at dawn instead of the end time.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Everlights lights to include. Leave empty for every zone on the bridge.

delete_show.name: Delete show
delete_show.description: Deletes a scheduled show and all of its nights. To drop a single night, delete it from the calendar.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the show to delete.

update_show.name: Update show
update_show.description: Changes a scheduled show in place. Anything you leave empty stays as it is.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the show to change.

sequences.name: Sequences
sequences.description: Replaces the show's sequences. Names mapped to seconds, or a plain list of names for 20 seconds each.

start.name: Start
start.description: New start of the first night. Needs an end as well.

end.name: End
end.description: New end of the first night. Needs a start as well.

nights.name: Nights
nights.description: How many nights in a row, counted from the new start. Leave empty to keep the same number.

start_at_dusk.name: Start at dusk
start_at_dusk.description: Turn starting at dusk on or off.

end_at_dawn.name: End at dawn
end_at_dawn.description: Turn ending at dawn on or off.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Replaces the zones the show runs on.
